# Cross-cutting risks

## Money

:::{warning} Exchange rates move against the budget
:class: hb-risk hb-likelihood-low hb-impact-medium
risk | likelihood: low | impact: medium | mitigation: Price the largest costs in the currency of the income.

This applies when costs and income use different currencies.
:::
